meta.name: upMVC Agent Knowledge Pack
meta.purpose: Portable startup context for any AI agent working on upMVC or upMVC-SaaS projects
meta.usage: Load this file at session start together with upmvc-rules.json. Do not ask the user to explain framework basics.

philosophy.summary: Pure PHP MVC. Modules are optional reference implementations. Minimal core, explicit control, no ORM required.
principles: Modules auto-discovered — drop folder in src/Modules, routes register automatically
PDO prepared statements — no magic query builder required
Config from .env via Environment::get() and ConfigManager::get()
Framework stays out of the way — app-specific patterns belong in app layer, not core

paths.app_root: UPMVC_APP_ROOT or project root (dirname above src/)
paths.env_file_note: Copy from src/Etc/.env.example — canonical path loaded by Environment::load()
paths.packages_registry: src/Etc/packages.php (optional — create when using Composer packages; upMVC-SaaS ships one)
paths.note_module_etc_config: Module etc/config.php files are generator metadata — not loaded by runtime unless you wire them yourself

flow: public/index.php defines UPMVC_APP_ROOT and loads vendor/autoload.php
new Start() → ConfigManager::load(), ErrorHandler (APP_DEBUG), request init
Start::upMVC() → Router, Application::registerProviders(), global middleware, named middleware

priority: 2. ConfigManager structured config (app, database, cache, session, security, mail, logging)
3. Config.php legacy fallbacks (site_path, domain_name, static session defaults)

important_env.APP_DEBUG: Controls error display — use this, not APP_ENV alone
important_env.PROTECTED_ROUTES: Comma-separated route prefixes requiring session auth
important_env.ROUTE_USE_CACHE: Module discovery cache — overrides production auto-detect when set
important_env.CACHE_DRIVER: file | array — default cache store for CacheManager
important_env.LOG_PATH: Error log directory (relative to app root or absolute)

avoid: $_ENV['KEY'] for .env values — putenv does not populate $_ENV

routing.discovery: InitModsImproved scans src/Modules/*/Routes/Routes.php and nested Modules/*/Modules/*/Routes/Routes.php
route_methods: addRoute(path, controller, method, middleware[], methods[]) — middleware is 4th argument array
addParamRoute(path, controller, method, middleware[], constraints[], methods[]) — supports {id:int} typed params in $_GET
routing.middleware_registration: Start.php registers global + named middleware (csrf, rate_limit, jwt, auth, cors)
routing.protected_routes: PROTECTED_ROUTES in .env merges with Start::$defaultProtectedRoutes and Application::addProtectedRoutes()

named.rate_limit: IP rate limit via Security::rateLimit + security.rate_limit config
named.cors: Route-level CORS (global CORS preferred when cross-origin)

middleware.note_cors_tag: Adding 'cors' to route middleware array only works if cors named middleware is used; global CORS uses CORS_ENABLED in .env

modules.generator: Optional: load docs/agent/upmvc-scaffolds.json via upmvc-next.php --scaffold (replaces removed PHP generators)
modules.philosophy: Bundled modules (Auth, Admin, React*, etc.) are reference implementations — delete what you do not need

packages.summary: Composer packages extend upMVC via optional src/Etc/packages.php provider registry
packages.registry_note: File is optional in standalone upMVC; required pattern for upMVC-SaaS and library-mode apps

application_api.addModulePath: Register extra module scan paths — prepend for pack, append for app overrides
application_api.bootProviders: Called after middleware registration — wire routes, factories

packages.module_path_order: Pack paths registered first; app src/Modules scanned last so app routes override pack routes

library_mode.description: When upMVC is a Composer dependency, host app defines UPMVC_APP_ROOT before autoload so Application resolves host paths for .env, packages.php, and local modules

cache_and_tools.legacy_cache: App\Etc\Cache — older file cache using Config::get('cache.enabled') — prefer CacheManager for new code
cache_and_tools.admin_route_cache_note: Admin dynamic routes cache at src/Etc/storage/cache/admin_routes.php; module discovery uses storage/cache via CacheManager
cache_and_tools.agent_cli: php src/Tools/upmvc-next.php — builds agent prompt from this knowledge pack
cache_and_tools.migrate_cli: php src/Tools/migrate.php [--status|--dump|--baseline|--fresh|--root=/path] — applies pending migrations from every registered path, then regenerates database/schema.sql

database.summary: Migrations are the source of truth. schema.sql is generated from them. seed.sql is hand-written demo data.

files.database/migrations/*.sql: hand-written, append-only — the source of truth
files.database/schema.sql: GENERATED by migrate.php --dump — never edit by hand, it is overwritten on every run
files.database/seed.sql: hand-written demo data (users). Scoped deletes only — must not wipe rows it did not create
files.database/README.md: install routes, flag reference, demo logins

database.run_order: kernel → packages → app, via Application::getMigrationPathsForRun(). This is the REVERSE of getModulePathsForRoutes(), where the app comes last so it can override package routes. Migrations need the opposite because the SaaS pack's refresh_tokens declares a foreign key to the kernel's users table.
database.path_registration: The kernel registers its own database/migrations and the app's in Application::__construct(). Packages add theirs from a service provider: $app->addMigrationPath($packRoot . '/database/migrations')

two_install_routes.migrations: php src/Tools/migrate.php — tracked in a migrations table, safe to re-run, applies future changes cleanly
two_install_routes.plain_sql: mysql < database/schema.sql then database/seed.sql — no tooling, but the migrations table stays empty; run migrate.php --baseline afterwards or a later migrate replays everything

database.filename_uniqueness: Tracking is by bare filename, so a migration name must be unique across kernel, packages and app. migrate.php hard-errors on collisions rather than silently skipping the second one.

security_baseline.csrf: Security::csrfToken() in forms; validate on POST
security_baseline.rate_limiting: Security::rateLimit for simple; App\Common\Helpers\RateLimiter for per-action file-persisted limits

agent_behavior.user_experience: User is already inside the framework — do not make them explain upMVC basics. Ask what they want to build, then plan.
agent_behavior.plan_output: JSON plan with steps, files_touched, config_changes, risks — wait for approval before writing files
agent_behavior.when_unsure: Read existing module in src/Modules as reference before inventing patterns
